data_provenance: Verified via web search (Sep 2026): NTA/NMC pattern, single paper, all questions compulsory (Section B removed from 2025 onward), pen-and-paper (OMR) mode.
important_caveat: NTA can revise exact structure each cycle; a re-exam for a subset of candidates was held 21 Jun 2026 under the same pattern after the main 3 May 2026 sitting. Prefer seeded ExamPaperPattern documents when present; this file is the seed source of truth for 2026.

exam_day.re_exam_note: Re-exam held for a subset of affected candidates under the identical pattern; not a second mandatory sitting for all candidates.
exam_day.note: Unlike JEE Advanced, NEET UG is one paper, one sitting, no morning/afternoon split.
